items.statement: Non-sterile pharmaceutical products are manufactured in a controlled environment as defined by the manufacturer.
items.quote: The manufacture of non-sterile pharmaceutical products should take place in a controlled environment, as defined by the manufacturer.

items.statement: HVAC system design is closely coordinated with the architectural design of the building.
items.quote: The design of the HVAC system should be closely coordinated with the architectural design of the building.

items.statement: Unfiltered air is prevented from infiltrating the manufacturing facility, as it can be a contamination source.
items.quote: Infiltration of unfiltered air into a manufacturing facility should be prevented as this can be a source of contamination.

items.statement: Manufacturing facilities are normally kept at positive pressure relative to outside to keep contaminants out.
items.quote: Manufacturing facilities should normally be maintained at a positive pressure relative to the outside, to prevent the ingress of contaminants.

items.statement: Where a facility is to be kept at negative pressure relative to outside, special precautions are taken to mitigate the risks.
items.quote: Where facilities are to be maintained at negative pressures relative to the outside, special precautions should be taken to mitigate any risks (see (3)).
items.condition: where facility kept at negative pressure to outside

items.statement: Manufacturing areas, especially where materials and products are exposed, have an appropriate cleanliness level, set by (at least) the products made, the process and the products' susceptibility to degradation.
items.quote: Areas for the manufacture of products, especially where materials and products are exposed to the environment, should be of an appropriate level of cleanliness. The level of air cleanliness for different areas should be determined according to, but not limited to, the products manufactured, the process used and the products’ susceptibility to degradation.

items.statement: Where a clean room classification is specified, the manufacturer states whether it applies to the as-built, at-rest or operational condition.
items.quote: Where a clean room classification is specified, the manufacturer should state whether the classification is rated for the “as-built”, “at-rest” or “operational” condition.
items.condition: where a clean room classification is specified

items.statement: HVAC systems achieve the specified room conditions, e.g. via heating, cooling, filtration, air distribution, airflow rates and air change rates.
items.quote: HVAC systems should ensure that the specified room conditions are attained, for example through heating, cooling, air filtration, air distribution, airflow rates and air exchange rates.

items.statement: Any area where starting materials, products, primary packing materials, utensils or equipment are exposed has the same cleanliness level or classification as the production area for the products.
items.quote: Any area where pharmaceutical starting materials, products, primary packing materials, utensils and equipment are exposed to the environment should have the same level of cleanliness or classification as the area in which the products are produced.
items.condition: where materials, products, utensils or equipment are exposed

items.statement: Premises and HVAC design and controls are in place to achieve containment, cleanliness and appropriate protection of product, personnel and environment.
items.quote: Appropriate design and controls for the premises and HVAC systems should be in place to achieve containment, cleanliness and the appropriate levels of protection of the product, personnel and the environment.

items.statement: Detailed schematic diagrams are maintained showing, for example, supply and return air, room pressure differentials and airflow directions.
items.quote: Detailed schematic diagrams should be maintained, indicating, for example, air supply and air return, room pressure differentials and airflow directions.

items.statement: Where possible, personnel and materials do not move from a higher to a lower cleanliness zone and back to a higher one.
items.quote: Where possible, personnel and materials should not move from a higher cleanliness zone to a lower cleanliness zone and back to a higher cleanliness zone.

items.statement: Where such back-and-forth movement between cleanliness zones cannot be avoided, the risks are identified and controlled.
items.quote: Where this is unavoidable, risks should be identified and controlled.
items.condition: where movement higher-lower-higher zone is unavoidable

items.statement: The final change room is at the same at-rest cleanliness level as the area it leads into.
items.quote: The final change room should be at the same cleanliness level (at rest) as the area into which it leads.

items.statement: Where appropriate, e.g. where opening both airlock doors together could cause cross-contamination, airlock doors are not opened simultaneously.
items.quote: Where appropriate, such as where the simultaneous opening of airlock doors might lead to a cross-contamination risk, airlock doors should not be opened at the same time.
items.condition: where simultaneous opening might cause cross-contamination risk

items.statement: In those cases, controls such as interlocks, warning systems and procedures are implemented to stop airlock doors opening together.
items.quote: In such cases, controls such as interlocking systems, warning systems and procedures should be implemented.
items.condition: where simultaneous opening of airlock doors must be prevented

items.statement: Swing doors normally open towards the high-pressure side and have self-closers.
items.quote: Swing doors should normally open to the high-pressure side and be provided with self-closers.

items.statement: Any exception to the door swing direction (e.g. fire escapes or other health and safety measures) is justified.
items.quote: Exceptions to the door swing direction should be justified and may include for fire escapes or other health and safety measures.
items.condition: where door swing direction is an exception

items.statement: Where door swing exceptions apply, door closer mechanisms are carefully controlled and other controls are in place to prevent risk.
items.quote: In these cases, door closer mechanisms should be carefully controlled and other controls should be in place to prevent any risk.
items.condition: where door swing direction exceptions apply
